visualCharacteristics.purpose: Office finder: region tabs, office cards and a map
visualCharacteristics.description: From 768px: underlined region tab bar (ARIA tablist, arrow keys), then a sideways-scrolling row of 398px grey office cards (country label above, bold uppercase company, pin + address) with square navy arrow buttons and a white fade, then a 610px Leaflet map with one pin per office coloured by type, and a 3-item legend (manufacturing red, sales navy, conversion grey). Clicking a card or pin turns the card navy with a cut corner and opens a popup (company, type, address, phone, e-mail). Phones: an accordion of regions (plus / red minus), the open region's cards stacked in a 398px scroll box (the active card also shows type, phone and e-mail), the map below at 375px, no legend. Leaflet (unpkg CDN) and the map tiles load only when the block is within 300px of the viewport; zooming is disabled as on the source.
visualCharacteristics.source: About us and Contact us: .about-map (.abouts-us-map-tabs, .cards-wrapper, #map Leaflet, .map-legend).

reuseGuidance: Use for any list of offices or sites grouped by region that should appear on a map. Tabs follow the order regions are first named; consecutive offices in the same country share one country label. Marker type words: manufacturing, sales, conversion (default sales). Offices without valid coordinates still get a card but no pin.
